Metadata.title: Aura Estética | Your treatment in Türkiye, supported from Spain
Metadata.description: Clear guidance, selected clinics and coordinated travel support for people considering treatment in Türkiye.

Home.title: Your treatment in Türkiye, supported from Spain.
Home.description: Selected clinics and professionals, clear information and a coordinated experience so you can decide calmly and travel with a plan.
Home.heroAlt: Patient speaking with a coordinator in a bright clinic
Home.cardTitle: Taking your time is part of your care.
Home.cardDescription: Human guidance and coordination at every step.
Home.specialtiesDescription: Explore our coordination areas and learn what information you need before travelling.
Home.trustTitle: We coordinate more than a transfer.
Home.trustDescription: We help you understand the process, meet the responsible team and coordinate the travel experience, accommodation and transport. Healthcare belongs to the responsible centre.
Home.footerRights: General information subject to clinical assessment and provider confirmation.

Specialties.title: Specialties to explore with confidence
Specialties.description: We help you understand available options and prepare an initial conversation with selected centres and professionals.
Specialties.processTitle: The process starts before you travel
Specialties.processDescription: We collect what is needed, coordinate communication with the centre and explain the next steps. Aura does not diagnose or replace the healthcare team.

Lead.title: Let's talk about what you are looking for.
Lead.description: An Aura advisor will call to understand your goal, explain the process and help you explore travel options and contact with the right centre. The call itself does not confirm treatment.
Lead.name: Full name
Lead.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what you would like to explore
Lead.messageHelp: Do not share sensitive medical information in this field.
Lead.companion: I would travel with a companion
Lead.consent: I agree that Aura Estética may contact me about my request.
Lead.pending: The call provides guidance; clinical indication belongs to the healthcare team.

Clinics.title: Selected clinics and professionals
Clinics.description: Explore published information about the centres and teams we can connect you with.
Clinics.pendingTitle: We are verifying our partner network.
Clinics.pendingDescription: Before publishing a clinic or professional, we will review specialties, authorisations, available services, languages and international patient support.

Process.title: How it works
Process.description: We support you from the first conversation, coordinate your travel experience and facilitate contact with the responsible healthcare centre.
Process.oneDescription: We learn about your goal, answer your questions and collect only what is needed to begin.
Process.twoDescription: We help you understand the process and facilitate a conversation with the right centre. The medical team decides suitability.
Process.threeDescription: We coordinate dates, accommodation and transport according to the confirmed proposal and provider terms.
Process.fourDescription: We support the practical side. Consultation, treatment, hospital care and clinical follow-up belong to the healthcare centre.

Footer.rights: General information subject to clinical assessment and provider confirmation.
